```python
def get_child_with_renamed_prefix(prefix, replacement, child):
    if isinstance(child, Node):
        # Correctly handle Node-based objects, ensuring recursive renaming
        return rename_prefix_from_q(prefix, replacement, child)
    
    if isinstance(child, tuple):
        lhs, rhs = child
        # Replace the prefix in the lhs of the tuple
        lhs = lhs.replace(prefix, replacement, 1)
        # Recursively apply renaming in the rhs if it has resolvable expressions
        if hasattr(rhs, "resolve_expression"):
            rhs = get_child_with_renamed_prefix(prefix, replacement, rhs)
        return lhs, rhs
    
    if isinstance(child, F):
        # Copy the F object and rename prefix
        child = child.copy()
        child.name = child.name.replace(prefix, replacement, 1)
    elif hasattr(child, "resolve_expression"):
        # Handle generic resolvable expressions with source expressions
        child = child.copy()
        child.set_source_expressions(
            [
                get_child_with_renamed_prefix(prefix, replacement, grand_child)
                for grand_child in child.get_source_expressions()
            ]
        )
    
    return child
```

3. **`F` and Other Expression Types**: For `F` objects and any object with `resolve_expression`, copy and then update the name or source expressions, ensuring prefixes are replaced properly.
